title: CPF Module Schema: PostgreSQL Flexible Server Database module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-postgresqldatabase'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

charset.description: (optional) Specifies the Charset for the Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server database.

collation.description: (optional) Specifies the Collation for the Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server database.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

database_name.description: (Optional) Custom name for the PostgreSQL Flexible Server database. If null, module-generated naming is used.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

server_id.description: (Required) Specifies the PostgreSQL Flexible server ID to associate it with database.

id.description: The ID of the PostgreSQL Flexible Server Database.

name.description: The name of the PostgreSQL Flexible Server Database.

resource.description: The Postgresql Flexible Server Database resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Postgresqldatabase' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
